# zswap-memo-companion frozen vectors -- the off-chain companion
# WRAPPER container (spec "Off-chain companion wrapper", FR-011;
# plan 00003 Phase 3 task 1). SC-006 names the wrapper codec among
# the things an independent implementation must reproduce exactly.
#
# Format and provenance: see vectors/README.md.
#
# DO NOT hand-edit. Regenerate with:
#   cargo run --bin gen_vectors
#
# Container layout:
#
#   magic          27 bytes  "midnight:zswap-memo-wrapper"
#   version        u16 LE    1
#   section_count  u16 LE
#   sections       section_count x:
#       tag        u16 LE
#       len        u32 LE
#       payload    len bytes
#
# Sections MUST appear in strictly ascending tag order and the whole
# container MUST be exactly consumed, so there is exactly one byte
# string per wrapper value: `encode` and `decode` are inverse both
# ways. Tags <= 0x0fff are mandatory (an unknown one is a typed
# reject); tags above it are optional and an unknown one is ignored.
#
# `proof` here is a DETERMINISTIC STAND-IN, not a real companion
# proof: a real one is 4,832 bytes of prover output that differs on
# every run (independent prover randomness, SC-003) and could never
# be frozen. These vectors pin the CONTAINER, not the cryptography.
# Likewise `statement` rows are a generated pattern; what a real row
# must contain is verified by rebuilding it from the canonical input
# (FR-005), never by reading it out of a wrapper.
